activeSlice.scope: Reduce Hunter V2 shadow cost and latency under unchanged rollout thresholds, stabilize genuine exploration across brands, and emit explicit human-readable test evidence (brand name, discovery topics, sanitized queries, paid-search selection, selected recommendation topics/buckets) only when an explicit evidence-detail flag is enabled.
successCriteria: Operational V2 uses at most three paid Agent Reach intents per run while keeping all planned lexical intents active on available free sources.
Paid intent selection is deterministic and always reserves an exploration paid slot when lexical adjacent exploration exists.
Independent source calls and lexical intents execute concurrently while final evidence ordering remains deterministic.
Deep-analysis requests execute concurrently with deterministic result ordering and isolated failure handling.
Exploration-only retrieval signals are not merged into non-exploration clusters, preserving genuine adjacent evidence through EEI.

Explicit test-only evidence detail records brand name, discovery topics, sanitized intent queries, paid-search selection and selected recommendation topics/buckets without raw source content or account identifiers.

A 3-brand x 3-run pre-gate must meet cost ratio <=1.5, p95 latency ratio <=1.5, retrieval coverage >=0.85, failure rate <=0.05, exploration share >=0.08, and quality delta >=-0.02 before a full 30-pair gate is attempted.
The full 30-pair gate uses unchanged HI2-09 thresholds.
Hunter V1 remains production authority and Hunter V2 performs no opportunity persistence.
Canary remains disabled unless the completed full shadow gate passes.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
